## Checklist

Details: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-a-pull-request).

- [ ] **Enforcement:** the tool checks a development standard automatically and can fail a build.
- [ ] **Public source:** official public repository and documentation (links below).
- [ ] **Currency:** last release, recent commits, maintainers, archived or deprecated status, successors or forks, open critical issues checked.
- [ ] **Alternatives:** main current alternatives found and compared.
- [ ] **Overlap:** overlap with existing recommendations checked.
- [ ] **Why:** reason to add or replace is explained.
- [ ] **Limits:** significant limitations stated.
- [ ] **Style:** README entry follows the format, `tools.json` updated, `node scripts/check-registry.mjs` passes.
